title: HC sync — interview loop + debrief action plan (scratchpad)
content:
Purpose:
- Prep notes for upcoming HC sync + 1:1 with Priya (people ops) — focus on interview loop tweaks and concrete debrief actions to reduce time-to-offer and improve quality signal.

Quick headcount snapshot (for sync):
- FY26 Q1 committed headcount delta: +9 (forecasted) but hiring velocity currently ~+4/mo at current interview-to-offer.
- Critical roles: Infra SRE (2 IC), Serving Runtime Engineer (2), Senior Product Designer (1).
- Backfills: Eng manager (west), QA lead (europe).
- Open offers: 3 (2 pending reference checks, 1 negotiating comp) — risk: one likely to fall through (pending reference).

Goals for this meeting:
- Get alignment on top-5 hires this quarter and whether to re-prioritize any reqs.
- Decide on immediate interview loop changes (rounds, evaluators, rubric) to speed throughput without harming quality.
- Assign owners for debrief fold changes and candidate experience follow-ups.

Interview-loop observations (pain points):
- Current loop has 4 rounds for mid-senior ICs: screening (recruiter), technical screen, take-home, on-site. Time from screen->offer median = 28 days.
- Bottlenecks: scheduling on-site panels (hard to align), inconsistent debrief format (freeform notes), take-home turnaround lag.
- Signal issues: technical screeners often focus on trivia instead of system-design for senior roles.

Proposed low-friction changes (pilot for next 4 reqs):
1) Standardize debrief template (one-pager) — 6 fields: role-fit, system-design, depth-of-knowledge, communication, areas-to-train, hire-recommendation (yes/prob/maybe) + 2 example anchors. Owner: Aisha. Deadline: 2026-03-20.
2) Replace take-home for senior infra roles with a 90-min paired design exercise (synchronous) to reduce turnaround. Owner: Diego. Pilot start: 2026-03-24.
3) Move compensation conversation to recruiter+candidate after first on-site scheduling to reduce late-stage surprises. Owner: Kenji. Implementation: update recruiter playbook (link in artifacts).
4) For panel scheduling, create a 2-week recurring "interview block" slot per team (Mon/Tue 10-1) to reduce calendar ping-pong. Owner: Team Leads. Proposal due: 2026-03-17.

Debrief rubric (draft — to include in new template):
- Score each dimension 1-5. Quick anchors: 5 = exceeds expectations with clear, sharable artifacts; 3 = meets expectations with gaps; 1 = misses fundamentals.
- Must include 1 concrete example per dimension (e.g., candidate explained cache eviction policy and tradeoffs with complexity vs perf).
- Recommendation logic: If system-design <=2 OR depth-of-knowledge <=2 -> automatic no for senior IC unless manager escalation with evidence.

Candidate experience tweaks:
- Send interview day agenda 48h in advance with panel names + focus areas. Small ask: include one "prep link" (confluence doc) so candidates know scope of design exercise.
- Post-interview: recruiter sends debrief summary + next steps within 48h. Measure: target 80% within 48h.

Scheduling & availability notes:
- Hiring manager (Nellie) out 2026-03-14 to 2026-03-23 (constrain on-site dates).
- Preferred on-site weeks: 2026-03-30 and 2026-04-13.

Prioritization framework (short):
- Score each req by (impact x urgency x hire-difficulty). Use quick 1-5 multiplies; escalate top 3 to exec for fast-track.

Action items (concrete) — owners + dates:
- Aisha: Draft standardized debrief template + upload to shared drive. Due 2026-03-20.
- Diego: Design paired exercise prompts for infra/systems. Due 2026-03-22.
- Kenji: Update recruiter playbook language re: comp timing and candidate day agenda. Due 2026-03-18.
- Priya: Reserve two interview-block windows in team calendars (trial month). Due 2026-03-17.
- Nellie: Identify top 5 must-hire reqs and confirm manager-level prioritization. Due before sync 2026-03-16.
- Recruiting ops: Add 48h post-interview SLA metric to dashboard (metric id: HIRE-SLA-48). Owner: Sarita. Due 2026-03-25.

Follow-ups for 1:1 with Priya:
- Quick run-through of prioritization scores for the 12 open reqs.
- Confirm budget headroom for two immediate backfills.
- Ask for historical data on time-to-offer by team (last 6 months) — link to report asked (Confluence).

Risks / open questions:
- If paired exercise increases interviewer load, how do we avoid slowing other pipelines? Consider rotating panel roster or capped interviews/week.
- Compensation competitiveness: need market comp check for senior infra across SF / remote. Linked ask: Comp benchmarking doc (ask finance).
- Legal: any IP concerns with paired design exercises (we'll ensure non-prod prompts).

Notes to self / things to raise in sync:
- Emphasize quick wins (debrief template + scheduling blocks) — low lift, high impact.
- Keep take-home removal limited to senior infra pilot — don't broadly remove without data.
- Track candidate NPS (quick thumbs up/neutral/down) after on-site to validate experience changes.

Random scratch ideas (may or may not use):
- "Interview buddy" program where new hires shadow hiring panels to expand panel pool.
- Small stipend for take-home to speed return rate (test with 2 reqs).

End of scratchpad.

Recent changes log (meta):
- 2025-11-03: created initial HC planning notes.
- 2026-02-14: added prioritized roles list and open-offer snapshot.
- 2026-03-10: updated owners and pilot dates after sync w/ Priya.

TODO (personal): Move finalized template to shared_drives/people-ops/interview-templates once approved.
